name: Walid Maalej
headline: World Citizen with 💔+🧠, Award-Winning Software Professor, Passionate Mentor // All My Personal Opinion
summary:
Walid Maalej is an award-winning software researcher, passionate educator, and handicraft enthusiast. As Professor of Informatics at the University of Hamburg he teaches software development basics to 500-700  students using fun activities and pair-programming. His advanced software engineering courses often include a big portion of Data, Machine Learning, and Empiricism and are based on real challenges from industry and society. During the pandemic, he has led the entire informatics department and had to simultaneously manage a large exceptional budget cut. 

In 2014 Prof. Maalej was named “The Early Stage Scientist of the Year” by academics and the German Association of University Professors (DHV). His work was cited thousands of times and received a.o. the ACM SIGSOFT Distinguished Paper Award, IEEE RE Best Paper Award, MSR Most Influential Paper Award, as well as Awards by Google and Microsoft.

Prof. Maalej worked as developer, manager, and consultant for numerous companies and organizations including Siemens, Tata Consultancy Services, Rohde und Schwarz, and Telekom. He received his doctoral degree from TU Munich with distinction and is also a proud alumni of the Center for Digital Technology and Management.

Follow his recent scientific publications here: 
https://scholar.google.de/citations?user=zVlpAfQAAAAJ&hl=en

company.name: ACM, Association for Computing Machinery
company.tagline: The world's largest professional organization advancing #computing as a science and profession.
company.description:
ACM, the Association for Computing Machinery, is the world's largest educational and scientific computing society, uniting educators, researchers and professionals to inspire dialogue, share resources and address the field's challenges.

As a leading global source for scientific information, ACM promotes computer research and innovation through its journals, magazines, and the proceedings of more than 170 annual conferences and symposia. ACM authors are among the world's leading thinkers in computing and information technologies, providing original research and firsthand perspectives.

Founded at the dawn of the computer age, ACM’s reach extends to every part of the globe, with more than half of its more than 100,000 members residing outside the U.S. Its growing membership has led to Councils in Europe, India, and China, fostering networking opportunities that strengthen ties within and across countries and technical communities. Their actions enhance ACM’s ability to raise awareness of computing’s important technical, educational, and social issues around the world.
